entries.title: Watch a documentary on the corporate capture of UK festival Boomtown
entries.description: Simon Doherty's short film asks "When the hyper-commodification of human joy and the perception of public safety butts heads with our privacy, where do we draw the line?"

entries.title: Dark Entries to release two archival albums from 'Lou Reed of gay porn' J.D. Slater
entries.description: Filling Your Silence and Elbow Deep In The Hoopla will be available on October 16th.

entries.title: Sonny Fodera to donate £1 from every 2027 arena ticket to UK grassroots music
entries.description: The contributions from his four March 2027 shows will go to LIVE Trust, which funds venues, artists and other parts of the UK grassroots sector.

entries.title: Sound Metaphors Festival returns to Berghain next month
entries.description: The three-day event will feature performances from Mohammad Reza Mortazavi, Alessandro Cortini, Z@p and more.
